description: Utility class for handling Akka-Http specific operations, particularly retrieving the raw request URI from an HttpRequest object.

classes.name: HttpUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for extracting raw request URI information from Akka-Http HttpRequest objects.

methods.name: getRawRequestUri
methods.description: Retrieves the raw request URI from an HttpRequest object, returning the header value if enabled; otherwise, returns the URI as parsed by Akka-Http with a warning log.
